anchor_value: Fair Value column should be USD-denominated; CAD/GBP appears only in Par Amount / Shares

culprit_citations.quoted_text: Onyx-Fire Protection Services Inc. | (6)(13)(15)(17) | First Lien Term Loan | C + 4.50 % | 6.77 % | 7/31/2031 | CAD 18,453 | 13,287 | 13,445 | 0.67
Onyx-Fire Protection Services Inc. | (6)(7)(13)(15)(17) | First Lien Revolver | C + 4.50 % | 6.77 % | 7/31/2031 | CAD 4,378 | 201 | 213 | 0.01
Mclarens Midco Inc. | (7)(13)(15)(17) | First Lien Revolver | SON + 4.75 % | 8.44 % | 12/19/2027 | GBP 499 | - | ( 3 ) | -

findings.detail: Foreign-currency labels from Par Amount / Shares were propagated into fair_value_currency even though the Fair Value column is separate and USD-denominated.

rationale: FX02 is a real localized extraction error. In the source SOI header, Par Amount / Shares is a separate column from Amortized Cost and Fair Value. The cited CAD and GBP rows place CAD/GBP only before the par amount, followed by separate fair value figures such as 13,445, 213, 20,413, (3), and 2,641. The stored fair_value_currency therefore inherited the local par currency rather than the USD fair value denomination expected for BDC valuation fields.
